<output>{"issues":[{"number":24,"tag":"easy-call","duplicate_of":null,"comment":"easy-call: resolve insert-select conflict paths inside their existing target scopes.

The change is internal to SemanticQueryBuilder.visitInsertStatement and BaseSqmToSqlAstConverter.visitInsertSelectStatement, with query regression tests. Two-way: no public API, schema, or persisted-format change.

Verified at upstream 24e81f56: HQL registers the target in stateFieldsProcessingState, pops it, then visits the conflict in the source registry. SQL AST conversion likewise pops the target state before visiting conflict paths. Insert-values already retains the appropriate scope.

After HQL source parsing, re-push the existing isolated target-fields state just for conflict parsing, with a finally pop. Preserve source-before-conflict ordering so WITH CTEs remain available, and do not leak source aliases into conflict paths.

Move SQL AST conflict conversion into the existing target-processing try before its finally, leaving source conversion outside. Extending the target state around source conversion changes QuerySpec/QueryGroup topLevel; restoring a target state after source changes the lastPoppedProcessingState returned by translate().

Use HQL and criteria insert-select regressions independently, plus target/source alias isolation, bind values, update assignments, insert-values and path-free controls. Existing InsertConflictTests and criteria-copy coverage provide the harness.

No runtime tests have yet run. Require genuine focused RED/GREEN and formatting checks in Actions, preserve source query shape/criteria-copy behavior, and obtain independent review before publication. Jira is New/unassigned/unresolved; no duplicate or competing PR was found."}],"patterns":""}</output>
